title: DNMT3L Neuron: analysis code for stage-aware multi-omic study of Down syndrome neurodevelopment
description: Analysis code, configuration files, and reproducibility documentation associated with the manuscript 'Stage-aware multi-omic analysis prioritizes DNMT3L-associated methylation programs in Down syndrome neurodevelopment'. The repository supports public transcriptomic, methylomic, chromatin-accessibility, motif, and regulatory-context analyses.
